summary: Huachen AI Parking Management filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report) disclosing the mechanics of a previously announced 20-for-1 share consolidation effected October 23, 2026, and the resulting warrant exercise-price reset. The Event Market Price, the lowest VWAP over the five trading days before through five after the consolidation (period ended October 30, 2026), was US$2.9779, and ordinary warrant exercise prices were reduced accordingly. During the adjustment period certain holders exercised warrants for cash, yielding 20,980 Class A ordinary shares; roughly 901,942 warrants remain outstanding. No board recommendation, advisor, price-per-share deal or transaction terms were stated; this is a routine capital-structure report, not a special situation. Watch warrant dilution and overhang as remaining warrants are exercised.
